preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(p, str) for p in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the returned list are strings.
The number of permutations is equal to the factorial of the length of the string S.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(p) == sorted(S) for p in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each permutation is a rearrangement of the characters in the original string S.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] < return_value[i + 1] for i in range(len(return_value) - 1))
postconditions.description: The permutations are in lexicographically sorted order.
